clue.text: Do some home improvement — add bar?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: repaint or repaper a room
second meaning, read cryptically: a bar is an extra award added to a medal, so adding one decorates someone again

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the playful second reading: re-decorate, as in honouring a soldier a second time with a bar to a medal.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing up a room with new paint or paper is the everyday sense; the medal sense splits the word into re plus decorate.

clue.text: A little of whatever is known is dangerous thing

explanation.surface: A twist on the proverb that a little knowledge is a dangerous thing.
explanation.definitionFit: A hazard or danger is something that exposes you to harm, the noun sense of the answer.

clue.text: Person who puts clothes on sideboard

definitions.meaning: first meaning: someone who dresses actors or others
second meaning: a kitchen cabinet with shelves for plates

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as someone laying clothes on a sideboard; the two halves are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre dresser helps performers into costume, and a Welsh dresser is a sideboard with display shelves.

clue.text: Moscow's anger disturbed new politician in Washington? Not he

indicators.note: things disturbed are thrown out of their settled order, so these letters get rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: Russian fury unsettles a fresh American legislator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not he' rules out the masculine version, pointing to a female member of the US Congress.
explanation.definitionFit: A female member of the US House of Representatives sits in Washington and is a she, not a he.

clue.text: Lots of people supporting reading or writing old language

explanation.walkthrough: The three Rs are reading, writing and arithmetic, so either of the first two can stand for R.
explanation.definitionFit: The Romani people's own tongue is called by this name, an Indo-Aryan language.

clue.text: It's most pleasant to consume wine in trial

parts.note: a trial is a test

explanation.walkthrough: 'To consume' looks like a container signal but belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Food with the best flavour is the most delicious thing to eat, the superlative of tasty.

clue.text: Long, narrow point or points turned round

parts.note: tips are points or ends

explanation.surface: A description of pointed shapes, then a rotated set of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A long thin strip of land jutting into the sea is a geographical term for a narrow headland.

clue.text: Situation of plant on part of golf course that can be problem when driving

parts.note: a pot plant sits in a pot
a golf course is divided into holes

explanation.surface: A golfing scene where driving off the tee goes wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Driving' looks like golf, but the definition means driving a car on a damaged road.
explanation.definitionFit: A pit in the road surface is a hazard for motorists, jolting the car and damaging tyres.

clue.text: It raised sum, we hear, in bank, in irritating way

indicators.note: in a down answer, raising a word makes it read from bottom to top

parts.note: the word it, turned upward

indicators.note: one piece goes inside another word, placed within it

indicators.note: what we hear is a word spoken, standing for a different spelling with the same sound

parts.note: said aloud, sum is identical to some

explanation.surface: A financial tale of money raised and deposited, told in a tedious way.
explanation.walkthrough: TI then RE(SOME)LY: 'bank' is the verb, as in banking on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb describes doing something in a wearisome, annoying manner.

clue.text: Bone in rump, centre thereof

thereof points back to rump, and its centre is its middle two letters

explanation.surface: An anatomy note locating a bone at the back of the body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thereof' sends you back to rump a second time, this time for its middle letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The breastbone is the flat bone in the chest to which the ribs attach.

clue.text: It's said to eliminate noise, say, in camera component

parts.note: sh is uttered to silence people
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: A camera part that supposedly cuts out sound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's said' looks like a sound-alike signal, but it describes the hushing sound.
explanation.definitionFit: The device in a camera that opens and closes to expose the film or sensor to light.

clue.text: Stupid group of workers, none the less, report information in it

parts.note: a trade union is an organised body of workers
none is nothing, shaped like zero
to report is to tell

indicators.note: one word is placed inside another, sitting within it

parts.note: taken as written
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: A dim union that still files its report with data included.
explanation.walkthrough: 'None the less' looks like the stock phrase meaning however, but splits into none (zero) and less (take away). GEN is British slang for information.

clue.text: Luckily found our destinies transformed, seizing power

parts.note: taken as written
P is the symbol for power in physics

explanation.definitionFit: A happy accident, something discovered by chance rather than design, is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Show lasting effects of accidents in fast vehicles

parts.note: to sport something is to wear it for show
scars are the marks left by injuries

explanation.surface: Crash victims' marks visible in speedy cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Low, high-performance two-seater automobiles built for speed are the plural noun here.

clue.text: Period in which ringleader's imprisoned as part of sentence

parts.note: a phase is a period of time
read as ring plus leader: the leading letter of ring

explanation.walkthrough: 'Ringleader' must be split: ring plus leader, its first letter. 'Sentence' suggests a jail term but is grammatical.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of words forming a unit within a grammatical sentence is the linguistic term.

clue.text: Feature of meteorological chart in middle of this other map

indicators.note: the letters sit in the middle of a run of words, lying inside them

parts.note: spans the end of this, all of other and the start of map

explanation.surface: A weather map with a line drawn through its centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A line on a weather chart joining places of equal temperature is a standard meteorological term.

clue.text: Odd man out in high position

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A strange outsider occupying a lofty post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Odd man out' is a stock phrase, but odd is the signal and the rest the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A peak rising high above the surrounding land is a lofty place in the literal sense.

clue.text: Material for violins, etc revolted conductor

parts.note: people who revolted rose up

explanation.surface: An orchestra mutinies against its conductor over instrument timber.

clue.text: Leather-worker not so happy about pound

parts.note: the comparative of sad

explanation.surface: A craftsman glum about his earnings.

clue.text: Like animals or birds, but not necessarily fish

definitions.text: Like animals or birds, but not necessarily fish

parts.words: Like animals or birds, but not necessarily fish
parts.note: surface reading: a zoological trait shared by creatures of land and air but not of water

parts.words: Like animals or birds, but not necessarily fish
parts.note: setter's reading: the words themselves are grammatical forms, and fish may be singular or many

explanation.walkthrough: Animals and birds end in s as grammatical forms of more than one; fish is the same singular or not.
explanation.definitionFit: The grammatical number denoting more than one is shown by animals and birds, while fish can be either.

clue.text: Managed game in East, supported by Asian city

parts.note: to run something is to manage it
go is a board game from East Asia
a thing resting on another is supported by it

clue.text: Fruit a couple of Romans found in this state

taken as written
two in Roman numerals

clue.text: Process of depositing tainted monies corruptly

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Start of scene in plane — it's not serious, so to speak

parts.note: the first letter of scene

clue.text: A powerful explosive article about US city, initially, or another

clue.text: A tiny covering so minute it's amazing

taken as written
